exercises.instructionEn: Match the sentences (a - g) to the pictures (1 - 7). Then, read out the events in the correct order. Can you guess who the young woman was?
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni (a - g) rasmlarga (1 - 7) moslang. So'ng voqealarni to'g'ri tartibda o'qing. Yosh ayol kim ekanini taxmin qila olasizmi?
exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI RASM - YETTI VOQEA.


TO'G'RI TARTIB (rasm raqami bo'yicha):

  1 - d  Janice was watching TV.
  2 - a  Janice saw a young woman
         standing at the door.
  3 - f  Janice went to the telephone
         and asked the local taxi service
         to collect the young woman.
  4 - b  The woman's flowers were lying
         on the doormat.
  5 - e  When James got home, she was
         still sitting on the stairs with
         the flowers on her lap.
  6 - g  James noticed an old photograph.
  7 - c  James showed Janice the
         photograph.


⚠ YoSh AYoL KIM EDI:

  Rasmlarga qarang: 7-rasmda James
  ESKI SURATNI ko'rsatadi va Janice
  hayratda qoladi.

  ⚠ Demak suratdagi ayol - eshik oldida
  turgan yosh ayolning O'ZI.
  ⚠ Bu - ARVOH hikoyasi ('a ghost
  story') - 2-mashqning javobi.


⚠ MATNDAGI ZAMONLAR:

  PAST CONTINUOUS (davomli):
     'Janice WAS WATCHING TV.'
     'The flowers WERE LYING on the
      doormat.'
     'she WAS STILL SITTING on the
      stairs'

  PAST SIMPLE (bir martalik ish):
     'Janice SAW a young woman.'
     'Janice WENT to the telephone.'
     'James NOTICED an old photograph.'
     'James SHOWED Janice the
      photograph.'

  ⚠ Bu - 4-unitning grammatika mavzusi:
  past simple va past continuous farqi.


⚠ 'TO SEE SB DOING STH':

  'Janice saw a young woman STANDING at
   the door.'
  = turgan ayolni ko'rdi.

  ⚠ Ko'rish/eshitish fe'llaridan keyin
  -ING shakli JARAYoNNI bildiradi.


⚠ 'TO LIE' - IKKI XIL:

  'The flowers were LYING on the mat.'
  ⚠ lie - lay - lain (yotmoq)
  ⚠ -ING shakli: LYING ('lieing' XATO)

  ⚠ 17-betdagi maqolda ham 'lie' bor edi:
  'so you must lie upon it'.


⚠ 'A LAP':

  = tizza usti (o'tirganda).
  ⚠ 'with the flowers on her LAP' =
  gullar tizzasida.


⚠ 'TO COLLECT':

  = olib ketmoq, borib olmoq.
  ⚠ 'to collect sb' = kimnidir borib
  olmoq (mashinada).
  ⚠ Boshqa ma'nosi: to'plamoq
  (19-betda 'collectors' bor edi).

exercises.instructionEn: Guess the type of story. Is it a humorous story, a science fiction story, a crime story, a horror story, a love story, a ghost story or a fairy tale? Who are the characters in the story? What do you think it is about? Describe what you can see in the pictures.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoya turini taxmin qiling. Bu kulgili hikoyami, ilmiy-fantastikmi, jinoiy hikoyami, qo'rqinchli hikoyami, sevgi hikoyasimi, arvoh haqidagi hikoyami yoki ertakmi? Hikoyadagi qahramonlar kim? Sizningcha, u nima haqida? Rasmlarda nima ko'rayotganingizni tasvirlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYa TURLARI.

  a humorous story - kulgili hikoya
  a science fiction story - ilmiy-
     fantastik hikoya
  a crime story - jinoiy hikoya
  a horror story - qo'rqinchli hikoya
  a love story - sevgi hikoyasi
  a ghost story - arvoh haqidagi hikoya
  a fairy tale - ertak


⚠ QAYSI TUR:

  Rasmlarga qarang:
     • yosh ayol paydo bo'ladi va
       G'OYIB bo'ladi (2 va 4-rasm)
     • gullar qoladi
     • ESKI suratda o'sha ayol

  → Bu - GHOST STORY (arvoh haqidagi
  hikoya).


⚠ SO'ZLARNING TAHLILI:

  'humorous' - 'humour' (hazil) so'zidan
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'humour', AQShda 'humor',
  lekin sifat IKKALASIDA ham 'humorous'.

  'science fiction' - 'science' (fan) +
     'fiction' (badiiy to'qima)
  ⚠ Qisqartmasi: 'sci-fi' /ˌsaɪ ˈfaɪ/.

  'a crime' = jinoyat
  ⚠ 'a criminal' = jinoyatchi.

  'horror' = dahshat
  ⚠ 'horrible' = dahshatli.

  'a ghost' = arvoh, ruh
  ⚠ 'gh' - 'g' o'qiladi, 'h' JIM:
  /ɡəʊst/.

  'a fairy tale' = ertak
  ⚠ 'a fairy' = pari; 'a tale' = ertak,
  qissa.


⚠ 'A CHARACTER' - IKKI MA'NO:

  1) qahramon (kitobda, filmda)
  2) xarakter, xislat (6-betda shu
     ma'noda edi)

  ⚠ Bu yerda BIRINChI ma'no.

  ⚠ Bu usul 'predict and check' deb
  ataladi: avval rasm va sarlavhaga
  qarab TAXMIN qilinadi, keyin
  tinglab yoki o'qib TEKShIRILADI.

  ⚠ Taxmin qilgan o'quvchi matnni
  ancha yaxshi tushunadi - chunki u
  ALLAQAChON javob izlayotgan bo'ladi.

    lekin matnning O'ZI 27-betda bor,

⚠ 'IF' - IKKI MA'NO:

     'If it rains, we'll stay at home.'

     'Check IF your guesses were correct.'
     = taxminlaringiz to'g'ri ekanINI
       tekshiring

  ⚠ Ikkinchi ma'noda 'whether' bilan
  almashtirish mumkin.


⚠ 'A GUESS':

  'to guess' (fe'l) = taxmin qilmoq
  'a guess' (ot) = taxmin
  ⚠ 'u' JIM: /ɡes/.

exercises.explanationUz:
HAMMA IBORA HIKOYaDA BOR.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  it SOUNDS like    - ... ga o'xshaydi
  the FRONT door    - oldingi eshik
  a local TAXI service - mahalliy taksi
                      xizmati
  a(n) BOUQUET of flowers - guldasta
  to CHANGE one's clothes - kiyim
                      almashtirmoq
  a clock TICKING   - chiqillayotgan
                      soat
  WEDDING day       - to'y kuni
  to GASP in amazement - hayratdan
                      nafasi bo'g'ilmoq
  wedding ANNIVERSARY - to'y yilligi


⚠ 'IT SOUNDS LIKE ...':

  = ovozi ... ga o'xshaydi.
  ⚠ 'to sound' - HIS fe'li, keyin SIFAT
  yoki 'like' + OT keladi:
     'It sounds interesting.' (sifat)
     'It sounds LIKE a clock.' (ot)

  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'look like',
  'feel like', 'taste like', 'smell
  like'.


⚠ 'THE FRONT DOOR' va 'THE BACK DOOR':

  front door - ko'chaga chiqadigan eshik
  back door - orqa eshik (hovliga)


⚠ 'AN ANNIVERSARY':

  = yillik.
  ⚠ Lotincha 'annus' (yil) + 'versus'
  (aylanish).
  ⚠ Imlosi: IKKI 'n', IKKI 's'.

  ⚠ 'a birthday' - odam uchun;
  'an anniversary' - VOQEA uchun
  (to'y, tashkil topish).


⚠ 'A BOUQUET OF FLOWERS':

  ⚠ 'a bunch of flowers' ham to'g'ri va
  ko'proq ishlatiladi.
  ⚠ 'bouquet' - fransuzcha, /buˈkeɪ/.


⚠ 'TO CHANGE ONE'S CLOTHES':

  ⚠ 'one's' o'rniga egalik olmoshi:
  'change HIS clothes', 'change MY
  clothes'.
  ⚠ 'clothes' - HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA.

exercises.explanationUz:
YAQIN MA'NOLI SO'ZLARNI FARQLASh.


⚠ 'ALONE' va 'LONELY':

  alone = yolg'iz (HOLAT: birov yo'q)
  lonely = yolg'izlikdan qiynalgan
     (HIS-TUYG'U)

  ⚠ 'I live alone but I'm not lonely.'
  = Yolg'iz yashayman, lekin
    zerikmayman.

  ⚠ Hikoyada: 'Janice was ALONE in the
  house' - shunchaki birov yo'q edi.


⚠ 'TO LAY' va 'TO LIE' - ENG QIYIN
JUFTLIK:

  to LIE (yotmoq) - O'TIMSIZ:
     lie - lay - lain; -ing: LYING
     'The book is LYING on the table.'

  to LAY (qo'ymoq) - O'TIMLI:
     lay - laid - laid; -ing: LAYING
     'She is LAYING the table.'

  ⚠ Chalkashlik sababi: 'lie' ning
  O'TGAN ZAMONI 'LAY' - ya'ni 'lay'
  fe'lining O'ZI bilan bir xil!

  ⚠ Hikoyada: 'her flowers were LYING
  on the doormat' - gullar O'ZI yotardi.


⚠ 'TO CHANGE' va 'TO CANCEL':

  to change = o'zgartirmoq
  to cancel = BEKOR qilmoq

  ⚠ 3-bandda 'raining heavily' sababli
  sayohat BEKOR qilingan - 'changed'
  emas.


⚠ 'TIME' va 'AN HOUR':

  time = vaqt (umuman); soat
     ko'rsatgan vaqt
  an hour = 60 daqiqa

  ⚠ 'Your watch shows the correct TIME.'
  ⚠ 'The film lasts two HOURS.'


⚠ 'KNOWN' va 'FAMILIAR':

  known = mashhur, tanilgan
     ('well known for' - 8-betda)
  familiar = tanish (ilgari ko'rgan)

  ⚠ 'She looks FAMILIAR to me.' =
  Uni qayerdadir ko'rganga o'xshayman.
  ⚠ Hikoyada: 'There was something
  FAMILIAR about the woman.'

exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri predlogni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR - HAMMASI HIKOYaDA BOR.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  AT night          - kechasi
  waiting FOR sb    - kimnidir kutmoq
  to call FOR a taxi - taksi chaqirmoq
  to tell sb ABOUT sth - kimgadir
                      nimadir haqida
                      aytmoq
  to sit ON the stairs - zinapoyada
                      o'tirmoq
  to turn ON the light - chiroq yoqmoq
  ON sb's wedding day - kimningdir to'y
                      kunida


⚠ 'AT NIGHT' - ISTISNO:

  IN the morning / afternoon / evening
  AT night

  ⚠ 'in the night' ham uchraydi, lekin
  boshqa ma'noda ('tun davomida').


⚠ 'TO WAIT FOR':

  ⚠ 'wait' PREDLOGSIZ ishlatilmaydi
  (odam yoki narsa bilan):
  'wait FOR the bus', 'wait FOR me'.


⚠ 'TO CALL FOR' va 'TO CALL':

  'to call sb' = kimgadir qo'ng'iroq
     qilmoq
  'to call FOR a taxi' = taksi
     ChAQIRMOQ

  ⚠ Ikki ibora BOShQA ma'noda.


⚠ 'TO TELL SB ABOUT STH':

  ⚠ 'tell' dan keyin ODAM predlogsiz:
  'tell ME about it'.
  ⚠ 'say' dan keyin esa 'to':
  'say something TO me'.


⚠ 'TO TURN ON' va 'TO TURN OFF':

  turn on = yoqmoq (chiroq, televizor)
  turn off = o'chirmoq

  ⚠ 'on' va 'off' - ZARRAChA, shuning
  uchun to'ldiruvchi o'rtada bo'lishi
  mumkin: 'turn IT on'.


⚠ 'ON SB'S WEDDING DAY':

  ⚠ Kun oldidan 'ON': on Monday,
  on 15th April, on my birthday.

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'AT night' - ISTISNO.
⚠ Qolganlari: 'IN the morning/afternoon/evening'.

⚠ 'to wait FOR sb/sth' - predlog ShART.
⚠ 'wait somebody' - XATO.

⚠ 'to call FOR a taxi' = taksi chaqirmoq.
⚠ 'to call sb' (predlogsiz) = qo'ng'iroq qilmoq -
BOShQA ma'no.

⚠ 'tell' dan keyin ODAM predlogsiz, MAVZU
oldidan 'about'.
⚠ 'say' bilan esa: 'say sth TO sb'.

⚠ 'ON the stairs' - yuza ustida.
⚠ Hikoyada: 'She sat down ON the stairs.'

⚠ 'to turn ON' = yoqmoq; 'to turn OFF' = o'chirmoq.
⚠ To'ldiruvchi o'rtada bo'lishi mumkin:
'turn IT on'.

⚠ KUN oldidan 'ON': on Monday, on 15th April,
on my birthday.

exercises.instructionUz: Qalin harfli sifatlarni ro'yxatdagi yaqin ma'noli sifatlar bilan almashtiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
KUChLIROQ SIFATLAR.

  ⚠ Ro'yxatdagi sifatlar oddiy
  sifatlarning KUChLI shakli:

     frightened → TERRIFIED
        (qo'rqqan → dahshatga tushgan)
     big → HUGE
        (katta → ulkan)
     small → TINY
        (kichik → juda kichkina)
     glad → RELIEVED
        (xursand → yengil tortgan)
     tired → EXHAUSTED
        (charchagan → holdan toygan)


⚠ KUChLI SIFATLAR BILAN 'VERY'
IShLATILMAYDI:

  ✓ very big → ✗ very huge
  ✓ very tired → ✗ very exhausted

  ⚠ Ular o'rniga 'absolutely' yoki
  'completely' ishlatiladi:
     'absolutely huge'
     'completely exhausted'


MATNNING TO'LIQ ShAKLI:

  'Sam heard the fireman knock on the
   window. He was TERRIFIED, but he
   knew he had to get out. The flames
   were HUGE and he was very hot.
   Slowly, he moved towards the window.
   It was TINY and Sam didn't know if
   he could get through. He managed
   after many attempts and when he
   reached the ground he felt very
   RELIEVED. He suddenly realised that
   he was EXHAUSTED. All he wanted to do
   was to sleep.'


⚠ 'TO HEAR SB DO STH':

  'Sam heard the fireman KNOCK on the
   window.'
  ⚠ 'hear' dan keyin 'to' SIZ infinitiv -
  ish TUGAGANINI bildiradi.
  ⚠ 'heard him KNOCKING' - jarayonni
  bildiradi.


⚠ 'TO MANAGE':

  = uddasidan chiqmoq.
  ⚠ 'to manage TO DO sth' - infinitiv
  bilan.
  ⚠ Boshqa ma'nosi: boshqarmoq
  (21-betda 'management').


⚠ 'AN ATTEMPT':

  = urinish.
  ⚠ 'to attempt' = urinmoq.


⚠ 'RELIEVED':

  = yengil tortgan (xavf o'tgach).
  ⚠ 'relief' (ot) = yengillik.
  ⚠ 'What a relief!' = xayriyat!

exercises.explanationUz:
RAVISh YaSASh QOIDALARI.


1) ODDIY: SIFAT + -LY

  sudden → suddenLY
  loud   → loudLY


2) '-LE' BILAN TUGASA: '-LE' → '-LY'

  gentle → gentLY
  terrible → terribLY
  simple → simpLY

  ⚠ 'gentlely' - XATO.


3) '-AL' BILAN TUGASA: + -LY

  final → finalLY (IKKI 'l')
  usual → usualLY
  normal → normalLY

  ⚠ 'finaly' - XATO, ikkita 'l' kerak.


4) UNDOSh + 'Y' → '-ILY'

  pretty → prettILY
  heavy → heavILY
  happy → happILY
  easy → easILY


5) O'ZGARMAYDIGANLAR:

  hard → hard
  fast → fast
  late → late
  early → early
  straight → straight

  ⚠ 'fastly' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'hardly' MAVJUD, lekin 'deyarli
  emas' ma'nosida - BOShQA so'z.


6) QOIDASIZ:

  good → WELL

  ⚠ 'goodly' - XATO.
  ⚠ 'well' yana SIFAT ham bo'ladi:
  'I'm well' = sog'lomman.


⚠ 'PRETTILY' - KAM IShLATILADI:

  ⚠ 'pretty' ko'proq RAVISh sifatida
  ishlatiladi va 'ancha' ma'nosini
  beradi: 'pretty good' = ancha yaxshi.

exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan to'g'ri ravishni qo'ying, so'ng fe'l va ravishni birga ishlatib gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
FE'L + RAVISh BIRIKMASI.

  ⚠ Bu ham COLLOCATION: qaysi ravish
  qaysi fe'l bilan yuradi.


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'It was RAINING HEAVILY as John was
   going back home.'


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  to rain HEAVILY   - qattiq yomg'ir
                      yog'moq
  to sing SWEETLY   - shirin kuylamoq
  to shine BRIGHTLY - yorqin porlamoq
  to climb CAREFULLY - ehtiyotkorlik
                      bilan chiqmoq
  to shout LOUDLY   - baland ovozda
                      qichqirmoq
  to shake VIOLENTLY - qattiq silkinmoq


⚠ 'HEAVILY' - YoMG'IR UChUN:

  ⚠ 'to rain heavily' ✓
  ⚠ 'to rain strongly' ✗

  ⚠ 27-betdagi hikoyada ham:
  'It was raining HEAVILY outside.'


⚠ 'VIOLENTLY':

  = qattiq, shiddat bilan.
  ⚠ 'violence' (ot) = zo'ravonlik.
  ⚠ 'to shake violently' = qattiq
  silkinmoq (zilzila, qo'rquv).


⚠ 'BRIGHTLY':

  = yorqin.
  ⚠ 'bright' - 16-betdagi maqolada
  'iqtidorli' ma'nosida edi:
  'this bright young star'.


⚠ 'CAREFULLY':

  ⚠ Imlosi: 'care' + 'full' → 'careful'
  (BITTA 'l') → 'carefully' (IKKI 'l').


⚠ RAVISh GAPDA QAYERDA TURADI:

  Odatda FE'LDAN KEYIN:
     'It was raining HEAVILY.'
     'She sang SWEETLY.'

  ⚠ To'ldiruvchi bo'lsa - undan KEYIN:
     'He opened the door SLOWLY.'
     ('opened slowly the door' XATO)

exercises.instructionUz: Qarama-qarshi so'zlarni qo'ying, so'ng ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
QARAMA-QARShI SIFATLAR.

  good ≠ TERRIBLE
  cheap ≠ EXPENSIVE
  easy ≠ DIFFICULT
  boring ≠ INTERESTING
  long ≠ SHORT
  awful ≠ FANTASTIC


⚠ 'GOOD' NING BIR NEChA AKSI:

  good ≠ bad (oddiy)
  good ≠ terrible (kuchli)
  good ≠ awful (kuchli)

  ⚠ Ro'yxatda 'terrible' berilgan,
  chunki 'awful' 6-bandda ishlatilgan.


⚠ 'AWFUL' va 'FANTASTIC':

  awful = dahshatli, juda yomon
  fantastic = ajoyib, juda yaxshi

  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham KUChLI sifat.
  ⚠ 'awful' - 'awe' (hurmat aralash
  qo'rquv) so'zidan; hozir faqat
  salbiy ma'noda.


⚠ 'BORING' va 'INTERESTING':

  ⚠ IKKALASI ham -ING bilan tugaydi -
  bular NARSANI tasvirlaydi.
  ⚠ Odam haqida -ED shakli:
     'The film is BORING.' (film
        zerikarli)
     'I am BORED.' (men zerikdim)

  ⚠ Bu farq juda ko'p xato qilinadi.


⚠ 'EXPENSIVE' va 'CHEAP':

  ⚠ 22-betdagi 22-mashqda 'cheaper'
  va 'more expensive' bor edi.


⚠ 13-MAShQ BILAN BOG'LIQ:

  Bu sifatlar 13-mashqdagi dialogda
  ishlatiladi: fantastic/boring,
  cheap, awful/difficult,
  boring/good, long/interesting.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the story and match the sentences (A - D) to the numbered spaces (1 - 4) in the story, then explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyani o'qing va gaplarni (A - D) hikoyadagi raqamlangan bo'shliqlarga (1 - 4) moslang, so'ng qalin harfli so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
YETIShMAYOTGAN GAPNI TOPISh.

  ⚠ Hikoya matni 27-betda; unda to'rtta
  raqamlangan bo'shliq bor.


TO'RT GAP:

  A  Janice couldn't see her anywhere,
     so she picked up the flowers, went
     inside and phoned the taxi service
     again to cancel the call.

  B  Janice looked at it and gasped in
     amazement.

  C  Instead of her husband, though,
     Janice saw a young woman standing
     there.

  D  Then James noticed an old
     photograph next to the clock.


⚠ QANDAY TOPILADI - BOG'LOVChI
SO'ZLARGA QARANG:

  C  'Instead of her husband, THOUGH' -
     demak oldin ERI kutilgan bo'lishi
     kerak.

  A  'Janice couldn't see HER anywhere' -
     'her' = yosh ayol, demak oldin
     ayol tilga olingan.

  D  'THEN James noticed ...' -
     ketma-ketlik; James allaqachon
     uyda bo'lishi kerak.

  B  'Janice looked at IT' - 'it' =
     surat, demak oldin surat tilga
     olingan (D dan KEYIN).


⚠ 'INSTEAD OF':

  = ... o'rniga.
  ⚠ 'instead of' + OT yoki -ING.
  ⚠ 'instead' (yolg'iz) = uning o'rniga
  (gap oxirida).


⚠ 'TO GASP IN AMAZEMENT':

  = hayratdan nafasi bo'g'ilmoq.
  ⚠ 'to gasp' = nafasi bo'g'ilmoq,
  hayqirmoq.
  ⚠ 'amazement' = hayrat ('to amaze' -
  hayratda qoldirmoq).


⚠ 'TO PICK UP':

  = yerdan olmoq, ko'tarmoq.
  ⚠ Yana: 'to pick sb up' = mashinada
  borib olmoq.


⚠ 'TO CANCEL':

  = bekor qilmoq.
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'cancelLED' (ikki 'l'),
  AQShda 'canceled'.


⚠ 'ANYWHERE':

  = hech qayerda (inkor gapda).
  ⚠ "couldn't see her ANYWHERE" =
  uni HECh QAYERDA ko'rmadi.
  ⚠ 'nowhere' bilan bir xil ma'no,
  lekin 'nowhere' TASDIQ fe'l bilan
  keladi.

exercises.instructionEn: The Wedding Anniversary
exercises.instructionUz: To'y yilligi
exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYaNING TO'LIQ MATNI VA TARJIMASI
bandlarda berilgan (bo'shliqlar
to'ldirilgan holda).


⚠ HIKOYaNING SIRI:

  Eshik oldiga kelgan yosh ayol -
  Jeymsning BUVISI, 1910-yil 15-aprelda
  turmushga chiqqan.
  U o'sha kuni - TO'Y YILLIGIda -
  qaytib kelgan.

  ⚠ Ya'ni bu ARVOH haqidagi hikoya
  (26-betdagi 2-mashqning javobi).


⚠ SO'NGGI GAP - KALIT:

  "Well, that's her in the photograph -
   and today is 15th April. It's her
   WEDDING ANNIVERSARY."

  ⚠ 'an anniversary' = yillik.
  ⚠ 'a wedding anniversary' = to'y
  yilligi.


⚠ MATNDAGI ZAMONLAR - 4-UNIT
GRAMMATIKASI:

  PAST CONTINUOUS (uzun, fon):
     'Janice WAS ALONE ... WAITING for
      her husband'
     'It WAS RAINING heavily'
     'the wind WAS BLOWING'
     'She WAS WATCHING TV'
     'she WAS WEARING a long white dress'
     'her flowers WERE LYING on the
      doormat'
     'she WAS STILL SITTING on the stairs'
     'It WAS TICKING loudly'

  PAST SIMPLE (qisqa, bir martalik):
     'the doorbell RANG'
     'she OPENED the door'
     'the young woman SAID'
     'Janice REPLIED'
     'She WENT to the telephone'
     'She SAT DOWN on the stairs'
     'James LAUGHED'
     'he HEARD the sound'
     'He WENT into the room and TURNED
      ON the light'

  ⚠ Qoida: uzun ish - CONTINUOUS,
  uni bo'lgan qisqa ish - SIMPLE.


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR:

  alone       = yolg'iz
  heavily     = qattiq (yomg'ir haqida)
  to blow     = esmoq (shamol)
  sweetly     = shirin ohangda
  to reply    = javob bermoq
  a taxi service = taksi xizmati
  to collect  = borib olmoq
  puzzled     = hayron, tushunmayotgan
  a lap       = tizza usti
  a ghost     = arvoh
  softly      = sekin, ohista
  a wedding anniversary = to'y yilligi

tasks.en: The Wedding Anniversary
tasks.uz: To'y yilligi

tasks.en: It was half past ten at night and Janice was alone in the house, waiting for her husband to come home.
tasks.uz: Kechasi o'n yarim edi va Janice uyda yolg'iz, erining uyga qaytishini kutib o'tirardi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'half past ten' = 10:30.
⚠ 'AT night' - ISTISNO ('in the night' emas).
⚠ 'to wait FOR sb' - predlog 'for' (8-mashqda).
⚠ 'alone' = yolg'iz (7-mashqda).

tasks.en: It was raining heavily outside and the wind was blowing.
tasks.uz: Tashqarida qattiq yomg'ir yog'ardi va shamol esardi.
tasks.note:
⚠ PAST CONTINUOUS - hikoyaning FONI.
⚠ 'heavily' = qattiq (yomg'ir haqida);
'strongly' EMAS.
⚠ 'to blow' = esmoq (blow - blew - blown).

tasks.en: She was watching TV when the doorbell rang. "James has lost his keys again," she thought as she opened the door.
tasks.uz: U televizor ko'rayotganda eshik qo'ng'irog'i jiringladi. "Jeyms yana kalitlarini yo'qotibdi", - deb o'yladi u eshikni ocharkan.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'was watching' (uzun) + 'rang' (qisqa) -
4-unit grammatikasining ASOSIY qolipi.
⚠ 'to ring' - noto'g'ri fe'l: ring - rang - rung.
⚠ 'as' bu yerda = ... arkan, ... paytda.

tasks.en: [1 = C] Instead of her husband, though, Janice saw a young woman standing there. She was wearing a long white dress under her coat, and she was holding a bouquet of pretty flowers.
tasks.uz: [1 = C] Ammo eri o'rniga Janice u yerda turgan yosh ayolni ko'rdi. U paltosi ostidan uzun oq ko'ylak kiygan va chiroyli guldasta ushlab turardi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 4-mashqning 1-javobi.
⚠ 'instead of' = ... o'rniga.
⚠ 'saw sb STANDING' - -ING shakli jarayonni
bildiradi.
⚠ 'a bouquet' - 6-betdagi 4-mashqda ham bor edi.

tasks.en: "Excuse me," the young woman said sweetly. "Would it be all right if I used your phone to call for a taxi?"
tasks.uz: "Kechirasiz", - dedi yosh ayol shirin ohangda. "Telefoningizdan taksi chaqirsam bo'ladimi?"
tasks.note:
⚠ 'sweetly' - RAVISh ('sweet' + -ly).
⚠ 'Would it be all right if I used ...?' -
juda MULOYIM iltimos (past simple ishlatiladi).
⚠ 'to call FOR a taxi' - predlog 'for'
(8-mashqda).

tasks.en: "Oh, yes, of course," Janice replied. "I'll call one for you now."
tasks.uz: "Ha, albatta", - javob berdi Janice. "Hozir sizga chaqiraman".
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to reply' = javob bermoq ('to reply TO sb').
⚠ "I'll" - shu daqiqada qabul qilingan qaror.
⚠ 'one' = 'a taxi' (takrorlamaslik uchun).

tasks.en: She went to the telephone, asked the local taxi service to collect the young woman, and returned to the front door.
tasks.uz: U telefonga bordi, mahalliy taksi xizmatidan yosh ayolni olib ketishni so'radi va oldingi eshikka qaytdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to ask sb TO DO sth' - infinitiv bilan.
⚠ 'to collect sb' = borib olmoq.
⚠ 'the front door' = ko'chaga chiqadigan eshik
(6-mashqda).

tasks.en: The young woman wasn't there, but her flowers were lying on the doormat.
tasks.uz: Yosh ayol u yerda yo'q edi, lekin gullari poyandozda yotardi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'were lying' - PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'lying' - 'lie' fe'lidan ('lieing' XATO).
⚠ 7-mashqda 'laying/lying' ataylab qarshi
qo'yilgan.

tasks.en: [2 = A] Janice couldn't see her anywhere, so she picked up the flowers, went inside and phoned the taxi service again to cancel the call.
tasks.uz: [2 = A] Janice uni hech qayerda ko'rmadi, shuning uchun gullarni oldi, ichkariga kirdi va chaqiruvni bekor qilish uchun taksi xizmatiga yana qo'ng'iroq qildi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 4-mashqning 2-javobi.
⚠ 'anywhere' - INKOR gapda 'hech qayerda'.
⚠ 'to cancel' - Britaniyada 'cancelLED'
(7-mashqda).

tasks.en: She sat down on the stairs, puzzled by the young woman's mysterious disappearance.
tasks.uz: U yosh ayolning sirli g'oyib bo'lishidan hayron bo'lib zinapoyaga o'tirdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'puzzled' = hayron, tushunmayotgan.
⚠ 'to sit ON the stairs' - predlog 'on'
(8-mashqda).
⚠ 'a disappearance' = g'oyib bo'lish
('to disappear' fe'lidan).

tasks.en: There was something familiar about the woman, but Janice couldn't think what it was.
tasks.uz: Ayolda tanish nimadir bor edi, lekin Janice u nima ekanini o'ylab topolmadi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'familiar' = tanish (7-mashqda).
⚠ 'something familiar' - SIFAT 'something' dan
KEYIN turadi.
⚠ 'what it was' - o'zlashtirma so'roq: so'z
tartibi ODDIY.

tasks.en: When James got home half an hour later, she was still sitting on the stairs with the flowers on her lap.
tasks.uz: Yarim soatdan keyin Jeyms uyga kelganda, u hamon zinapoyada gullar tizzasida o'tirardi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'got home' (qisqa) + 'was sitting' (uzun) -
yana 4-unit qolipi.
⚠ 'half an hour' - 'AN hour' ('h' o'qilmaydi).
⚠ 'a lap' = tizza usti.

tasks.en: "What's the matter?" he asked. "You look as if you've seen a ghost."
tasks.uz: "Nima bo'ldi?" - so'radi u. "Arvoh ko'rganga o'xshaysan".
tasks.note:
⚠ "What's the matter?" = nima bo'ldi?
⚠ 'You look AS IF ...' = ... ga o'xshaysan.
⚠ 'to see a ghost' - shu ibora hikoyaning
MAVZUSIGA ishora qiladi.

tasks.en: "Perhaps I have," she said jokingly. She showed James the flowers, and told him about the strange woman.
tasks.uz: "Balki ko'rgandirman", - dedi u hazillashib. U Jeymsga gullarni ko'rsatdi va g'alati ayol haqida aytib berdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'Perhaps I have' = 'Perhaps I have seen a
ghost' - takroriy qism TUShIRIB QOLDIRILGAN.
⚠ 'jokingly' - RAVISh ('a joke' so'zidan).
⚠ 'to tell sb ABOUT sth' - predlog 'about'
(8-mashqda).

tasks.en: James laughed, then went upstairs to change his clothes.
tasks.uz: Jeyms kuldi, keyin kiyimini almashtirish uchun yuqoriga chiqdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to change one's clothes' = kiyim almashtirmoq
(6-mashqda).
⚠ 'upstairs' - PREDLOGSIZ ravish.
⚠ MAQSAD uchun INFINITIV: 'TO change'.

tasks.en: As he was going past the guest room, he heard the sound of a clock ticking.
tasks.uz: Mehmonxona yonidan o'tayotganda soatning chiqillashini eshitdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'As he WAS GOING' (uzun) + 'he HEARD' (qisqa).
⚠ 'past' bu yerda PREDLOG: 'yonidan o'tib'
(9-betdagi xatda ham bor edi).
⚠ 'a clock ticking' = chiqillayotgan soat
(6-mashqda).

tasks.en: "It sounds like the clock my grandparents had when I was a child," James thought, "but that stopped working twenty years ago."
tasks.uz: "Bu bolaligimda buvim-bobomda bo'lgan soatga o'xshaydi", - deb o'yladi Jeyms, "lekin u yigirma yil oldin ishlamay qolgan".
tasks.note:
⚠ 'It sounds like ...' = ... ga o'xshaydi
(6-mashqda).
⚠ 'to stop DOING sth' = qilishni to'xtatmoq;
'to stop TO DO sth' - butunlay boshqa ma'no!
⚠ 'ago' - gap oxirida.

tasks.en: He went into the room and turned on the light. His grandparents were no longer alive, but many of their things were still there.
tasks.uz: U xonaga kirdi va chiroqni yoqdi. Buvi-bobosi endi tirik emas edi, lekin ularning ko'p narsalari hamon u yerda edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to turn ON the light' = chiroq yoqmoq
(8-mashqda). Aksi: 'to turn off'.
⚠ 'no longer' = endi ... emas.
⚠ 'alive' - SIFAT, otdan OLDIN turmaydi
('an alive man' XATO; 'a living man').

tasks.en: James looked around and saw his grandparents' clock. It was ticking loudly and it showed the correct time.
tasks.uz: Jeyms atrofga qaradi va buvi-bobosining soatini ko'rdi. U qattiq chiqillayotgan va to'g'ri vaqtni ko'rsatardi.
tasks.note:
⚠ "grandparents'" - KO'PLIKDA egalik:
apostrof -S dan KEYIN.
⚠ 'the correct time' - 7-mashqda 'time/hour'
qarshi qo'yilgan.
⚠ 'loudly' - RAVISh.

tasks.en: [3 = D] Then James noticed an old photograph next to the clock. It was a picture of a young couple on their wedding day, with "15th April, 1910" written on the photograph.
tasks.uz: [3 = D] Keyin Jeyms soat yonidagi eski suratni payqab qoldi. Bu to'y kunidagi yosh juftlikning surati edi, unda "1910-yil 15-aprel" deb yozilgan edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 4-mashqning 3-javobi.
⚠ 'ON sb's wedding day' - predlog 'on'
(8-mashqda).
⚠ '15th April, 1910' - Britaniya sanasi:
kun → oy → yil.

tasks.en: James took the picture and went downstairs. "I know who the young woman was," he said softly, showing Janice the photograph.
tasks.uz: Jeyms suratni oldi va pastga tushdi. "Yosh ayol kim ekanini bilaman", - dedi u ohista, Janice'ga suratni ko'rsatib.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'downstairs' - PREDLOGSIZ.
⚠ 'who the young woman was' - o'zlashtirma
so'roq, so'z tartibi ODDIY.
⚠ 'softly' - RAVISh ('soft' + -ly).

tasks.en: [4 = B] Janice looked at it and gasped in amazement. The bride was wearing the same white dress as the young woman, and the flowers she was holding in the photograph were just like the ones Janice had.
tasks.uz: [4 = B] Janice unga qaradi va hayratdan nafasi bo'g'ildi. Kelin yosh ayolnikidek oq ko'ylak kiygan, suratdagi gullari esa Janice'dagi gullarga o'xshash edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 4-mashqning 4-javobi.
⚠ 'to gasp in amazement' (6-mashqda).
⚠ 'the same ... AS' - 22-betdagi qoida.
⚠ 'the ones' = 'the flowers' (takrorlamaslik
uchun).

tasks.en: "My grandmother died before I met you, didn't she?" James said. "Well, that's her in the photograph - and today is 15th April. It's her wedding anniversary."
tasks.uz: "Buvim men seni uchratishimdan oldin vafot etgan edi, shundaymi?" - dedi Jeyms. "Xo'sh, suratdagi - o'sha, va bugun 15-aprel. Bugun uning to'y yilligi".
tasks.note:
⚠ "didn't she?" - QUESTION TAG (15-unit mavzusi).
⚠ 'an anniversary' = yillik (6-mashqda).
⚠ Bu - hikoyaning KALIT gapi: yosh ayol
Jeymsning BUVISI edi.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  1  Janice was reading a book when the
     doorbell rang.
     → "She wasn't reading a book.
        She was watching TV."

  ⚠ IKKI QADAM:
     1) INKOR bilan rad etish
     2) TO'G'RI ma'lumot

  ⚠ 21-betdagi 20-mashq bilan bir xil
  g'oya, lekin bu yerda hamma gap
  PAST CONTINUOUS da.

  4  SITTING on the stairs (sleeping

⚠ PAST CONTINUOUS INKORI:

  She WASN'T reading.
  They WEREN'T sitting.

  ⚠ 'was/were' + not + fe'l + -ing.

exercises.instructionEn: Adjectives describe nouns. Adverbs usually describe verbs or other adverbs.
exercises.instructionUz: Sifatlar otni tasvirlaydi. Ravishlar odatda fe'l yoki boshqa ravishni tasvirlaydi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI 'USE' QUTISI.

  'ADJECTIVES describe NOUNS.
   ADVERBS usually describe VERBS or
   other adverbs.'

  'She was holding a bouquet of PRETTY
   flowers.'  (sifat + ot)
  '"Excuse me," the young woman said
   SWEETLY.'  (fe'l + ravish)


⚠ ASOSIY FARQ:

  SIFAT → QANDAY? (ot haqida)
     'a pretty flower' - qanday gul?

  RAVISh → QANDAY QILIB? (fe'l haqida)
     'she said sweetly' - qanday aytdi?


⚠ RAVISh QANDAY YaSALADI:

  SIFAT + -LY:
     sweet → sweetly
     soft  → softly
     loud  → loudly
     heavy → heavily (undosh + y → -ily)
     terrible → terribly ('-le' → '-ly')


⚠ QOIDASIZ RAVIShLAR:

  good → WELL   (⚠ 'goodly' XATO)
  fast → fast   (o'zgarmaydi)
  hard → hard   (o'zgarmaydi)
  late → late   (o'zgarmaydi)
  early → early (o'zgarmaydi)

  ⚠ 'hardly' MAVJUD, lekin ma'nosi
  BOShQA: 'deyarli emas'.
     'He works HARD.' = qattiq ishlaydi
     'He HARDLY works.' = deyarli
        ishlamaydi

  ⚠ 'lately' ham boshqa ma'noda:
  'so'nggi paytlarda'.


⚠ -LY BILAN TUGAGAN SIFATLAR:

  friendly, lovely, lonely, silly,
  ugly, likely

  ⚠ Bular SIFAT, ravish EMAS!
  ⚠ Ulardan ravish yasash uchun
  'in a ... way' ishlatiladi:
  'in a friendly way'.


⚠ HIS FE'LLARIDAN KEYIN SIFAT:

  be, look, seem, sound, feel, taste,

exercises.instructionEn: Form: We form the past continuous with was/were and the present participle of the main verb (verb + ing).
exercises.instructionUz: Yasalishi: Past continuous 'was/were' va asosiy fe'lning -ing shakli bilan yasaladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI 'FORM' QUTISI.

  'We form the past continuous with
   WAS/WERE (past tense of the verb
   TO BE) and the PRESENT PARTICIPLE
   of the main verb (verb + ing).'


AFFIRMATIVE (tasdiq):
  I / he / she / it WAS eating
  we / you / they   WERE eating

NEGATIVE (inkor):
  I / he / she / it WASN'T eating
  we / you / they   WEREN'T eating

INTERROGATIVE (so'roq):
  WAS I / he / she / it eating?
  WERE we / you / they eating?

SHORT ANSWERS (qisqa javob):
  Yes, I / he / she / it WAS.
  No, he / she / it WASN'T.
  Yes, we / you / they WERE.
  No, we / you / they WEREN'T.


⚠ 'WAS' va 'WERE' - KIM BILAN:

  WAS  - I, he, she, it
  WERE - we, you, they

  ⚠ DIQQAT: 'I WAS' (hozirgi zamonda
  'I am' bo'lgani kabi), lekin
  'YOU WERE' (hatto bitta odam
  bo'lsa ham).


⚠ -ING QO'ShISh QOIDALARI:

  eat   → eating   (oddiy)
  make  → making   (oxirgi 'e' TUShADI)
  sit   → sitting  (qisqa unli + bitta
                    undosh → IKKILANADI)
  lie   → lying    (-ie → -ying)
  travel → travelling (Britaniyada 'l'
                    ikkilanadi)


⚠ 'A PRESENT PARTICIPLE':

  = -ing shakli.
  ⚠ 'present' bu yerda 'hozirgi zamon'
  emas - shunchaki shaklning nomi.
  ⚠ U past continuous da ham,
  present continuous da ham bir xil.


⚠ TO'RT QO'LLANISh (17-mashq):

  a) IKKI YoKI UNDAN KO'P ish BIR
     VAQTDA:
     'She WAS WEARING a dress and she
      WAS HOLDING flowers.'

  b) HIKOYaNING FONI:
     'It WAS RAINING heavily outside.'

  c) UZUN ishni QISQA ish BO'LDI:
     'She WAS WATCHING TV when the
      doorbell RANG.'

  d) O'TMIShNING ANIQ PAYTIDA davom
     etayotgan ish:
     'It was half past ten and Janice
      WAS WAITING for her husband.'


⚠ 'WHEN' va 'WHILE':

  WHEN + past simple (qisqa ish)
     'when the doorbell rang'
  WHILE + past continuous (uzun ish)
     'while she was watching TV'

  ⚠ Ikkalasi bir gapda:
  'WHILE she was watching TV, the
   doorbell rang.'
  = 'She was watching TV WHEN the
     doorbell rang.'


⚠ HOLAT FE'LLARI CONTINUOUSDA
BO'LMAYDI:

  know, understand, want, like, love,
  hate, need, believe, remember

  ⚠ 'I was knowing' - XATO.
  ⚠ 20-mashqda 'be' fe'li ham SIMPLE
  da qoladi: 'It WAS Christmas Eve.'

  ⚠ Hamma gap 27-betdagi hikoyadan
  olingan.


QO'LLANIShLAR:

  a  two or more actions happening at
     the same time in the past

       ikki yoki undan ko'p ish

  b  background information in a story

  c  action interrupted by another
     shorter action in the past

  d  action in progress at a stated
     time in the past

       was waiting.'

  ⚠ Hikoyalar ko'pincha shunday
  boshlanadi: 'It was raining ...',
  'The sun was shining ...'


⚠ 'a' - BIR VAQTDA:

  Odatda 'and' yoki 'while' bilan
  bog'lanadi:
  'She was wearing a dress AND she was
   holding flowers.'
  'WHILE I was cooking, he was reading.'


⚠ 'TO INTERRUPT':

  = bo'lmoq, to'xtatmoq.
  ⚠ 'an interruption' = uzilish.

  am = tushgacha (ante meridiem)
  pm = tushdan keyin (post meridiem)

  ⚠ 12 am = yarim tun
  ⚠ 12 pm = tush payti
  ⚠ Bu ikkisi ko'p adashtiriladi.

  getting up, getting dressed, having
  breakfast, going to school, having
  lessons, having lunch, coming home,
  doing homework, watching TV, having
  dinner, sleeping

  ⚠ 'to hang' - noto'g'ri fe'l:

⚠ 'TO CUT THE GRASS':

  ⚠ 'to mow the lawn' ham to'g'ri.
  ⚠ 'cut' - noto'g'ri fe'l: cut - cut -
  cut (o'zgarmaydi).


⚠ 'TO WATER':

  ⚠ 'water' - OT ham, FE'L ham:
  'to water the flowers' = gullarni
  sug'ormoq.

  puzzled = hayron (tushunmaganidan)

  nervous = asabiy, o'zini noqulay his
     qiladi

  lekin 'anxious' KELAJAKDAGI voqeadan,
  'nervous' HOZIRGI holatdan.


⚠ 'THRILLED':

  = juda xursand, hayajonlangan.
  ⚠ 'a thriller' - shu so'zdan (hayajonli
  film yoki kitob).


⚠ 'WHO ON EARTH ...?':

  = kim ekan-a?
  ⚠ 'on earth' savolni KUChAYTIRADI

  ⚠ Yana: 'What on earth are you doing?'

  thrilled, puzzled, amazed - hammasi
  -ED bilan tugaydi va ODAMNING
  his-tuyg'usini bildiradi.

  ⚠ -ING shakli esa NARSANI tasvirlaydi:

     'I am amazED.'

  ⚠ Ro'yxatdagi so'zlar hikoyaning

  ularga qarab hikoyani boshdan-oxir
  aytish mumkin.


RO'YXAT (kitobdagi tartibda):

  watching TV, doorbell rang, young
  woman, long white dress, bouquet of
  flowers, called for a taxi, woman
  wasn't there, doormat, cancelled the
  call, puzzled, sat on the stairs,
  ghost, guest room, clock ticking, old
  photograph, wedding day, gasped in
  amazement, same white dress, 15th
  April, wedding anniversary


⚠ QAYSI ZAMONDA SO'ZLASh:

  Hikoya O'TGAN ZAMONDA:
     PAST CONTINUOUS - fon
     PAST SIMPLE - voqealar

  ⚠ 'Janice WAS WATCHING TV when the
  doorbell RANG.'


⚠ KETMA-KETLIK SO'ZLARI:

  First, ... - avval
  Then, ... - keyin
  After that, ... - shundan keyin
  Later, ... - keyinroq
  Finally, ... - nihoyat
  In the end, ... - oxir-oqibat

  ⚠ Bu so'zlar hikoyani BOG'LAYDI va
  tinglovchiga yo'l ko'rsatadi.

tasks.en: First, Janice was watching TV when the doorbell rang.
tasks.uz: Avval Janice televizor ko'rayotganda eshik qo'ng'irog'i jiringladi.

⚠ Bu - butun hikoyaning grammatik qolipi.

tasks.en: She opened the door and saw a young woman in a long white dress with a bouquet of flowers.
tasks.uz: U eshikni ochdi va uzun oq ko'ylakdagi, qo'lida guldastali yosh ayolni ko'rdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ Ikki fe'l bitta ega bilan: 'opened AND saw'.
⚠ 'in a dress' = ko'ylakda (kiyim uchun 'in').

tasks.en: Then Janice called for a taxi, but when she went back, the woman wasn't there and the flowers were lying on the doormat.
tasks.uz: Keyin Janice taksi chaqirdi, lekin qaytib kelganda ayol u yerda yo'q edi va gullar poyandozda yotardi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to call FOR a taxi' - predlog 'for'.
⚠ 'were lying' - PAST CONTINUOUS.

tasks.en: She cancelled the call and sat on the stairs, puzzled.
tasks.uz: U chaqiruvni bekor qildi va hayron bo'lib zinapoyaga o'tirdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'cancelled' - Britaniyada ikki 'l'.
⚠ 'puzzled' - SIFAT ('hayron bo'lgan').

tasks.en: When James got home, she told him about the woman. He joked that she looked as if she had seen a ghost.
tasks.uz: Jeyms uyga kelganda, u ayol haqida aytib berdi. Jeyms hazillashib, u arvoh ko'rganga o'xshaydi, dedi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to tell sb ABOUT sth' - predlog 'about'.
⚠ 'as if' = ... ga o'xshab.

tasks.en: Later, James heard a clock ticking in the guest room and found an old photograph next to it.
tasks.uz: Keyinroq Jeyms mehmonxonada soat chiqillashini eshitdi va uning yonidan eski suratni topdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a clock ticking' - -ING shakli jarayonni
bildiradi.
⚠ 'next to' = yonida.

tasks.en: It was a wedding day photograph dated 15th April, 1910.
tasks.uz: Bu 1910-yil 15-aprel sanasi qo'yilgan to'y kuni surati edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'dated' = sana qo'yilgan.
⚠ Britaniya sanasi: kun → oy → yil.

tasks.en: Finally, he showed it to Janice, who gasped in amazement: the bride was the young woman, and today was her wedding anniversary.
tasks.uz: Nihoyat, u buni Janice'ga ko'rsatdi va u hayratdan nafasi bo'g'ildi: kelin o'sha yosh ayol edi va bugun uning to'y yilligi edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'Finally' - xulosani boshlaydi.
⚠ 'to gasp in amazement' - turg'un ibora.
⚠ 'who' - nisbiy olmosh (12-unit mavzusi).

exercises.explanationUz:
TA'SSUROT SO'RASh VA AYTISh.

KITOBDAGI DIALOG:
  A: How was your holiday?
  B: It was fantastic/boring.
  A: Was the weather good?
  B: Yes, it was. / No, it wasn't.
     It was awful.


⚠ 'HOW WAS ...?':

  = ... qanday o'tdi?
  ⚠ Bu - tajriba haqida so'rashning
  eng oddiy qolipi.
  ⚠ 'What was it like?' ham to'g'ri.


⚠ QISQA JAVOB:

  'Was the weather good?'
     - 'Yes, it WAS.' / "No, it WASN'T."

  ⚠ Qisqa javobda savoldagi FE'L
  takrorlanadi.
  ⚠ Tasdiqda QISQARTMA IShLATILMAYDI:
  "Yes, it's" - XATO.


KO'RSATMALAR (yangi dialoglar uchun):

  • the concert/fantastic -
    the tickets/cheap?
  • your Maths exam/awful -
    the questions/difficult?
  • the play/boring -
    the actors/good?
  • the lecture/long -
    the lecturer/interesting?

  ⚠ Har ko'rsatmada IKKI qism:
     1) umumiy taassurot
     2) tafsilot haqida savol


⚠ SIFATLAR 12-MAShQDAN:

  fantastic, boring, awful, difficult,
  good, long, interesting, cheap -
  hammasi 12-mashqda o'rganilgan.


⚠ 'A LECTURE' va 'A LECTURER':

  a lecture = ma'ruza (16-betdagi
     dialogda ham bor edi)
  a lecturer = ma'ruzachi, o'qituvchi
     (universitetda)

exercises.instructionEn: Beginnings - Endings
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyaning boshlanishi va tugashi
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI.

  'At the BEGINNING of a story, we say
   WHERE and WHEN the story takes
   place, WHO the people are, and WHAT
   happened first.'

  'At the END of a story, we write WHAT
   HAPPENED IN THE END and HOW THE
   PEOPLE FELT.'


BOShLANIShDA TO'RT SAVOL:

  WHERE? - qayerda
  WHEN?  - qachon
  WHO?   - kim
  WHAT happened first? - avval nima
           bo'ldi

  ⚠ 20-mashqning 1-5 savollari aynan
  shu to'rt savolga tegishli.


TUGAShDA IKKI SAVOL:

  What happened in the end? - oxirida
     nima bo'ldi
  How did the people feel? - odamlar
     o'zini qanday his qildi

  ⚠ 20-mashqning 6-savoli aynan shu.


⚠ 27-BETDAGI HIKOYa ShU QOIDAGA
MOS KELADI:

  BOShLANIShI:
     WHEN: 'It was half past ten at
        night'
     WHERE: 'in the house'
     WHO: 'Janice ... her husband'
     WHAT FIRST: 'the doorbell rang'

  TUGAShI:
     WHAT IN THE END: 'that's her in the
        photograph'
     HOW FELT: 'gasped in amazement'


⚠ 'TO TAKE PLACE':

  = bo'lib o'tmoq, sodir bo'lmoq.
  ⚠ 23-betdagi 29-mashqda ham bor edi.


⚠ 'IN THE END' va 'AT THE END':

  in the end = oxir-oqibat, natijada
  at the end (of sth) = ... ning
     oxirida

  ⚠ 'IN THE END he came.' = oxir-oqibat
  keldi.
  ⚠ 'AT THE END of the film ...' =
  filmning oxirida.

  ⚠ Qutida IKKALASI ham bor - farqni
  seziing.

tasks.uz: Hikoya oxirida oxir-oqibat nima bo'lgani va odamlar o'zini qanday his qilganini yozamiz.

LAURA HAQIDAGI HIKOYaNING BOShI VA
OXIRI.


⚠ QAYSI ZAMON QAYERDA:

  PAST CONTINUOUS - fon va uzun ish:
     1 was staring (fon)
     3 was travelling (fon)
     5 was wearing (tasvir)
     6 was carrying (tasvir)
     14 was waiting (fon)

  PAST SIMPLE - qisqa, ketma-ket ish:
     2 was ('be' - HOLAT fe'li!)
     4 entered
     7 sat
     8 opened
     9 took
     10 gave
     11 got
     12 put
     13 walked
     15 thought


⚠ 2-BANDGA DIQQAT:

  'It 2) ... (be) Christmas Eve.'
  → 'It WAS Christmas Eve.'

  ⚠ 'be' - HOLAT fe'li, CONTINUOUS
  shaklda ISHLATILMAYDI.
  ⚠ 'It was being Christmas Eve' - XATO.


⚠ 4-BAND - 'SUDDENLY':

  'SUDDENLY an elderly gentleman
   4) ... (enter) her compartment.'
  → ENTERED

  ⚠ 'suddenly' = to'satdan - QISQA,
  kutilmagan ish belgisi → PAST SIMPLE.
  ⚠ Bu ish uzun 'was staring' ishini
  BO'LADI (17-mashqning 'c'
  qo'llanishi).


⚠ 7-10 BANDLAR - KETMA-KET IShLAR:

  sat → opened → took → gave

  ⚠ Hammasi PAST SIMPLE, chunki ular
  BIRIN-KETIN sodir bo'ladi.
  ⚠ Continuous bo'lsa, ular BIR VAQTDA
  bo'lgan bo'lardi - bu mantiqsiz.


⚠ NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR:

  take → took
  give → gave
  get  → got
  put  → put (O'ZGARMAYDI)
  sit  → sat
  think → thought


⚠ 12-BAND - 'PUT':

  'carefully 12) ... (put) the envelope'
  → PUT

  ⚠ 'put' - o'tgan zamonda ham 'put'!
  ⚠ 'putted' - XATO.


⚠ 'CHRISTMAS EVE':

  = Rojdestvo arafasi (24-dekabr).
  ⚠ 'an eve' = arafa.
  ⚠ 'New Year's Eve' = Yangi yil arafasi.


⚠ 'A COMPARTMENT':

  = poyezd kupesi.


⚠ 'AN ENVELOPE':

  = konvert.
  ⚠ /ˈenvələʊp/ deb o'qiladi.

  uchun REJA.


⚠ SAVOLLARDA ZAMONGA DIQQAT:

  'Where WAS Laura?' - past simple
  'What WAS she DOING?' - past
     continuous
  'When DID the story TAKE PLACE?' -
     past simple
  'Who ARE the people involved?' -
     PRESENT simple (hikoya HAQIDA

  hikoyani TAHLIL qilyapmiz.

  etgan odamlar.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and the prompts in the Photo File section and write a beginning and an ending for the story. Use the extracts in Ex. 20 as a model.
exercises.instructionUz: Photo File bo'limidagi rasmlar va ko'rsatmalarga qarang va hikoyaga boshlanish hamda tugash yozing. 20-mashqdagi parchalarni namuna qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYaGA BOSh VA OXIR YoZISh.


BOShLANISh - TO'RT SAVOLGA JAVOB:

  1) WHEN - qachon
     'It was a cold winter evening ...'
     'It was Christmas Eve ...'

  2) WHERE - qayerda
     '... on a train.'
     '... in a small village.'

  3) WHO - kim
     'Laura was travelling home ...'

  4) WHAT HAPPENED FIRST - avval nima
     'Suddenly, an elderly gentleman
      entered her compartment.'

  ⚠ 'SUDDENLY' - hikoyada voqeani
  boshlashning eng qulay so'zi.


TUGASh - IKKI SAVOLGA JAVOB:

  1) WHAT HAPPENED IN THE END
     'In the end, she found out that
      ...'

  2) HOW THE PEOPLE FELT
     'She felt very happy / sad /
      relieved.'

  ⚠ His-tuyg'u sifatlari 28-betdagi
  15-mashqda: thrilled, anxious,
  nervous, sad, puzzled, amazed.


⚠ QAYSI ZAMONLAR:

  FON va TASVIR → PAST CONTINUOUS
     'It was raining ...'
     'She was wearing ...'

  VOQEALAR → PAST SIMPLE
     'He entered ...'
     'She opened ...'

  ⚠ Bu - 20-mashqdagi matnning
  AYNAN qolipi.


⚠ KETMA-KETLIK SO'ZLARI:

  Suddenly, ... - to'satdan
  Then, ... - keyin
  After that, ... - shundan keyin
  Finally, ... - nihoyat
  In the end, ... - oxir-oqibat


⚠ 'AN EXTRACT':

  = parcha (matndan).
  ⚠ 'to extract' = ajratib olmoq.

tasks.en: It was a cold, wet evening in November and Tom was walking home through the empty park.
tasks.uz: Noyabrning sovuq, nam kechasi edi va Tom bo'sh bog' orqali uyiga piyoda ketayotgan edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ FON → PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ Ob-havo va joy - hikoyaning FONI
(17-mashqning 'b' qo'llanishi).

tasks.en: He was carrying a heavy bag and he was thinking about his exam the next day.
tasks.uz: U og'ir sumka ko'targan va ertangi imtihoni haqida o'ylayotgan edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ Ikki ish BIR VAQTDA → PAST CONTINUOUS
(17-mashqning 'a' qo'llanishi).

tasks.en: Suddenly, he heard a strange noise behind him. He turned round and saw a small dog running towards him.
tasks.uz: To'satdan u orqasida g'alati shovqin eshitdi. U o'girildi va o'zi tomon yugurib kelayotgan kichkina itni ko'rdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'SUDDENLY' + PAST SIMPLE - uzun ishni BO'LADI
(17-mashqning 'c' qo'llanishi).
⚠ 'saw a dog RUNNING' - -ING shakli jarayonni
bildiradi.

tasks.en: In the end, Tom took the dog home and found its owner the next morning.
tasks.uz: Oxir-oqibat Tom itni uyiga olib ketdi va ertasi ertalab egasini topdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'in the end' = oxir-oqibat.
⚠ Ketma-ket voqealar → PAST SIMPLE.

tasks.en: The owner was thrilled to see his dog again, and Tom felt very happy. It was a day he would never forget.
tasks.uz: Egasi itini yana ko'rganidan juda xursand bo'ldi, Tom esa o'zini juda baxtli his qildi. Bu u hech qachon unutmaydigan kun edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ His-tuyg'u sifatlari 28-betdagi 15-mashqdan.
⚠ 'a day he would never forget' - unit nomiga
ishora: 'Days to Remember'.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Janice was watching TV when she heard the doorbell.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Janice televizor ko'rayotganda qo'ng'iroq ovozini eshitdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ PAST CONTINUOUS - fon; PAST SIMPLE - uni
bo'lgan ish.
⚠ Bu 4-unitning grammatika mavzusi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Janice saw a young woman standing at the door.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Janice eshik oldida turgan yosh ayolni ko'rdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Ko'rish/eshitish fe'llaridan keyin -ING shakli
JARAYoNNI bildiradi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Instead of her husband, Janice saw a young woman.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Eri o'rniga Janice yosh ayolni ko'rdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'instead of' + OT yoki -ING.
⚠ 'instead' yolg'iz - gap oxirida.

sentencePatterns.formula: I think it is a [hikoya turi], because [sabab].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I think it is a ghost story, because the young woman disappears.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menimcha, bu arvoh haqidagi hikoya, chunki yosh ayol g'oyib bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Taxminni SABAB bilan asoslash - fikr
bildirishning to'liq shakli.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She was watching TV when the doorbell rang.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U televizor ko'rayotganda eshik qo'ng'irog'i jiringladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She wasn't reading a book. She was watching TV.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U kitob o'qimayotgan edi. U televizor ko'rayotgan edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Noto'g'ri gapni to'g'rilash: avval INKOR,
keyin TO'G'RI ma'lumot.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It sounds like the clock my grandparents had.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'sound LIKE' + OT; 'sound' + SIFAT.
⚠ Xuddi shunday: look like, feel like,
taste like.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You look as if you've seen a ghost.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'as if' = ... ga o'xshab.
⚠ 'look' dan keyin SIFAT yoki 'as if' + GAP.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: "Excuse me," the young woman said sweetly.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ RAVISh fe'lni tasvirlaydi: QANDAY QILIB aytdi?
⚠ Sifat + -LY.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It was raining heavily as John was going back home.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jon uyga qaytayotganda qattiq yomg'ir yog'ardi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ RAVISh fe'ldan KEYIN turadi.
⚠ 'as' = ... paytda (ikki uzun ish bir vaqtda).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How was your holiday? - It was fantastic.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Tajriba haqida so'rashning asosiy qolipi.
⚠ 'What was it like?' ham to'g'ri.

sentencePatterns.formula: Was/Were [nima] [sifat]? - Yes, it was. / No, it wasn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Was the weather good? - No, it wasn't. It was awful.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ob-havo yaxshi edimi? - Yo'q. Dahshat edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Qisqa javobda savoldagi FE'L takrorlanadi.
⚠ Tasdiqda qisqartma IShLATILMAYDI.

sentencePatterns.formula: I could hear [nima] [fe'l]-ing. / I couldn't hear [nima].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I could hear the wind howling. I couldn't hear a tap dripping.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shamolning uvillashini eshitdim. Jo'mrakning tomishini eshitmadim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'hear' fe'li bilan odatda 'can/could'
ishlatiladi.
⚠ Keyin -ING shakli davom etayotgan tovushni
bildiradi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: "The view is fantastic!" - He feels amazed.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'feel' - HIS fe'li, keyin SIFAT keladi
('feel badly' XATO).
⚠ -ED sifatlari ODAM haqida.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: At 6 am last Monday I was getting dressed.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'tgan dushanba soat 6 da kiyinayotgan edim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ O'tmishning ANIQ paytida davom etayotgan ish
(17-mashqning 'd' qo'llanishi).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Paul wasn't hanging out the washing. He was painting the door.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Pol kir yoymayotgan edi. U eshikni bo'yayotgan edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ To'g'rilashning IKKI QADAMI: avval INKOR,
keyin TO'G'RI ma'lumot.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It was raining heavily. Suddenly, someone knocked on the door.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qattiq yomg'ir yog'ardi. To'satdan kimdir eshikni taqillatdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ FON → past continuous; VOQEA → past simple.
⚠ 'Suddenly' - hikoyada voqeani boshlash so'zi.

sentencePatterns.formula: In the end, [nima bo'ldi]. He/She felt [his-tuyg'u].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In the end, he found the owner. He felt very happy.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oxir-oqibat u egasini topdi. U o'zini juda baxtli his qildi.
